_meta.title: ODIN PDUFA Runup Research — Complete Validated Findings
_meta.author: David Moore + Claude (ODIN Project)
_meta.dataset: 934 verified PDUFA events with price data (2020-2025), from 1,845 total verified events
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for PDUFA pre-catalyst runup trading strategy. Ingest this into any new chat for full context.

core_thesis.summary: Biotech stocks systematically appreciate 3-12% in the 25-30 trading days before PDUFA catalyst dates. This runup occurs regardless of whether the drug is ultimately approved or rejected (CRL). The optimal strategy is to buy T-25 to T-30 and exit T-5 to T-7, NEVER holding through the binary event.
why_it_works: Specialist biotech funds (Perceptive, RTW, RA Capital, Baker Bros) accumulate positions ahead of catalysts
Options market makers delta-hedge, creating mechanical buying pressure (gamma effect)
Retail FOMO amplifies as PDUFA date approaches
IV expansion in options creates synthetic demand for underlying shares
core_thesis.critical_insight: CRL stocks run up almost as much as approvals (+5.9% vs +7.7% for nano-cap T-25→T-7). The runup is driven by speculation and flow, NOT outcome prediction. This means the runup trade works regardless of what any model predicts for approval probability.

all_events_T25_to_T7.note: Full dataset including large-caps which dilute the signal

nano_cap_under_10_T30_to_T7.note: Longer hold captures more of the move but ties up capital

by_outcome_nano_T25_to_T7.insight: CRL stocks still run up. Proves the trade is flow-driven, not outcome-driven.

dead_money_zone.conclusion: NEVER hold through this window. Exit by T-7 (low confidence) or T-5 (high confidence).

window_capture_rates.note: T-25 is the sweet spot — captures 82% of the move with only 18 calendar days of capital commitment

specialist_fund_signal.finding: Stocks with specialist biotech fund interest have +12.6pp higher approval rates (90.1% vs 77.5%)
specialist_fund_signal.proxy_definition: Orphan OR BTD OR Rare Disease/Oncology TA OR designation_count >= 3

non_negotiable_rules: EXIT BY T-7 (Tier 3/4) or T-5 (Tier 1/2) — T-7→T-1 is dead money (+0.9% mean, 47% WR)
NO ENTRY AFTER T-15 — Late entries capture <58% of the move with maximum binary risk exposure
NO AVERAGING UP AFTER T-10 — FOMO buying in danger zone
WEEKEND PDUFA → EXIT THURSDAY/FRIDAY — No exit opportunity after weekend announcement
TIER_4 = NO TRADE — No exceptions regardless of revenue impact or alpha score

special_exit_cases.weekend_pdufa: Exit Thursday close — no exit opportunity after weekend announcement
special_exit_cases.stock_up_gt_30pct_from_entry: Take 50% profit — lock gains, reduce exposure

revenue_impact_module.purpose: Higher revenue impact = larger pre-PDUFA runup. Transformational drugs attract more specialist fund positioning, options hedging, and retail FOMO.

R1_transformational.description: Peak sales > 50% of current market cap
R1_transformational.examples: First-in-class drugs, gene therapies for rare disease

R2_significant.description: Peak sales 20-50% of current market cap

R3_moderate.description: Peak sales 5-20% of current market cap

R4_negligible.description: Peak sales < 5% of current market cap (big pharma line extensions)

alpha_score_composite.purpose: Combines multiple signals into a 0-100 composite score predicting runup magnitude

iv_slope.description: Front/back month IV ratio — steeper = larger expected move, more gamma hedging

smart_money.description: Insider trades + options flow (put/call ratio) + congressional trades

ta_quality.description: Therapeutic area runup quality (Rare Disease=1.0, Pain Management=0.0)

alpha_tiers.ALPHA_1_gte_80: Strong runup expected, maximum position size
alpha_tiers.ALPHA_4_lt_40: No meaningful runup expected, skip or minimum position

signals.cluster_buy_gte_3_insiders: STRONG_BULLISH — Multiple insiders buying = high conviction
signals.director_buy: MILD_BULLISH — Less informative but still positive
signals.any_sell: NEUTRAL_TO_BEARISH — Could be routine but timing matters

real_examples.APLS: P/C 6.97 avg / 25.33 max → EXTREME_BEARISH (correctly predicted issues)

congressional_trades.note: Low sample size, use as tiebreaker only. Any purchase within 90 days of PDUFA = potential signal.

iv_slope_signal.steep_gt_1.5: Market pricing large binary event → larger expected runup (gamma hedging amplifies buying)
iv_slope_signal.flat_lt_1.0: Market skeptical of catalyst significance → muted runup

iv_framework.limitation: Historical IV data NOT in our 934-event dataset. Framework based on documented biotech patterns and real-time observations. Live validation only.

STRADDLE_IV_EXPANSION.risk: Theta decay if IV doesn't expand

CALL_SPREAD_BULLISH.condition: ODIN Tier 1 or 2, R1/R2 revenue tier

SELL_PREMIUM_IV_CRUSH.risk: Unlimited on naked; defined on spreads

regime_detection.method: XBI-based regime detection using 50/200 day moving averages, drawdown from highs, golden cross/death cross, and VIX level

regimes.BULL: XBI above 200 MA, golden cross active, drawdown <10%, VIX <25
regimes.BEAR: XBI below 200 MA, death cross, drawdown >20%, VIX >30

regime_detection.regime_impact_on_runups: Bull regime amplifies runups; bear regime compresses them. Regime is an input to position sizing, not entry/exit timing.

gemini_claims_audit.purpose: Gemini AI produced a PDUFA Runup Master Report. We audited every claim against our 934-event dataset.
confirmed: Oncology and Rare Disease have largest runups ✅
gemini_claims_audit.root_cause: Gemini likely used hand-picked favorable sample and aggressive annualization (√(365/D) vs √(252/D))
gemini_claims_audit.bottom_line: Directional conclusions confirmed. Magnitude claims inflated 2-3×. Always use OUR corrected numbers.

size_cohort_definitions.note: Use actual market cap when available. Price-based proxy used when mcap data unavailable.

live_validation_targets_2026.note: These were the Q1-Q2 2026 targets. IRON and RGNX already resolved as CRLs.

IRON.note: False positive — FDA wanted Phase 3 APOLLO data

model_blind_spots_identified.IRON_false_positive: BTD+Orphan+Priority Review stacked to 91.9% but FDA wanted additional Phase 3 data. Model has no 'FDA wants more data' feature.
model_blind_spots_identified.SNY_false_positive: Major pharma + BTD scored 92.4% but severe DILI safety concern caused CRL. Model has no safety signal severity feature.
model_blind_spots_identified.resubmission_bias: RCKT scores 3.9% due to prior_crl + manufacturing_risk + inexperienced sponsor, but this is a resubmission specifically addressing manufacturing. Model may penalize resubmissions too heavily when the resubmission directly addresses CRL reasons.

key_takeaways_for_trading: 1. THE RUNUP IS THE TRADE. Buy T-25 to T-30, exit T-5 to T-7. Never hold through the binary event.
2. CRL stocks run up too (+5.9% nano-cap). The trade is flow-driven, not outcome-driven.
3. T-7→T-1 is dead money (+0.9%, 47% WR, 53% sell-the-news). NEVER hold through this window.
4. Rare Disease micro-caps are the MONSTER cohort (+11.8% mean, 68.8% WR, 2.3 Sharpe).
5. Pain Management is the DEAD ZONE (-7.8% mean, 37.5% WR). Avoid completely.
6. Specialist fund interest (BTD/Orphan/designation stacking) adds +3.8pp to nano-cap runups.
7. R1 revenue tier (transformational drugs) = 1.8× runup multiplier vs baseline.
8. TIER_4 = NO TRADE. No exceptions. This rule saved $4,958 per event on 180 historical CRLs.
9. T-25 captures 82% of the total move with only 18 calendar days. Best risk-adjusted entry point.
10. Weekend PDUFAs exit Thursday close. No negotiation.
